properties.displayName: Entra Agent ID - Unusual Agentic Sign-In from New IP or Country
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Detects agent-related Entra sign-ins from an IP or country not observed for the same agent identity during the previous 14 days, or sign-ins marked medium/high risk.
properties.query:
let CurrentWindow=1h;
let Lookback=14d;
let AllSignins = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs, AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
    | extend AgentData=todynamic(column_ifexists('Agent',dynamic({}))), AgentType=tostring(AgentData.agentType), ParentAppId=tostring(AgentData.parentAppId)
    | where isnotempty(AgentType) and AgentType !~ 'notAgentic'
    | extend IdentityKey=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('UserPrincipalName','')),tostring(column_ifexists('ServicePrincipalId','')),tostring(column_ifexists('Identity',''))),
             IPAddress=tostring(column_ifexists('IPAddress','')), Location=tostring(column_ifexists('Location','')),
             RiskLevelDuringSignIn=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskLevelDuringSignIn','')), RiskState=tostring(column_ifexists('RiskState','')),
             AppDisplayName=tostring(column_ifexists('AppDisplayName',''))
);
let Historical = AllSignins
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(Lookback)..ago(CurrentWindow))
| summarize KnownIPs=make_set(IPAddress,256), KnownCountries=make_set(Location,64) by IdentityKey, AgentType;
AllSignins
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(CurrentWindow)
| join kind=leftouter Historical on IdentityKey, AgentType
| extend IsNewIP=isempty(tostring(KnownIPs)) or not(set_has_element(KnownIPs,IPAddress)),
         IsNewCountry=isempty(tostring(KnownCountries)) or not(set_has_element(KnownCountries,Location))
| where IsNewIP or IsNewCountry or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') or RiskState in~ ('atRisk','confirmedCompromised')
| project TimeGenerated, IdentityKey, AgentType, ParentAppId, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, IsNewIP, IsNewCountry
